description: This file provides functions for creating, retrieving, and deleting cookies in JavaScript, including handling optional parameters like expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Creates or updates a cookie with specified name, value, and optional attributes such as expiration, path, domain, and secure flag.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by name, returning null if not found.

methods.name: deleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration date to the past.
